snippet.title: BREKEKEKEX - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
BREKEKEKEX is a short, third-person, melee-focused action brawler set in a foggy swamp overrun with frogs, cultists, bandits, and worse.

This isn't an RPG. There are no skill trees to grind and no stats to pad. There is only you, your skills, and the weight of your weapon. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4012150/BREKEKEKEX/

Developer: nohost 
X: https://x.com/nohost_dev

#indiegame #action #adventure #hackandslash
